steps.en: Install the scanner and select an uninstalled skill directory
steps.zh: 安装扫描器，选一个尚未安装的技能目录

steps.en: Request a static JSON scan with an incomplete-analysis gate
steps.zh: 请求静态 JSON 扫描，并拒绝不完整分析

steps.en: Inventory files and run the available analyzers without executing the skill
steps.zh: 清点文件并运行可用分析器，不执行技能

steps.en: Return findings, risk and completeness; fail the gate for incomplete analysis
steps.zh: 返回发现、风险与完整性；分析不全则闸门失败

steps.en: Review the evidence and decide whether to install under restricted permissions
steps.zh: 审查证据，再决定是否在受限权限下安装

value.en: An install decision has inspectable findings and coverage gaps, not only a low risk score
value.zh: 安装决策有可查的发现和覆盖缺口，不只看低风险分
